current_answer: Six official ambassador pages visibly invite applications without a published passed deadline: Hedera, Cyfrin, Nexo, Aster, Elk and Nomis. Bitget also has a Trading Builder recruitment campaign through 30 Sep 2026, but it is for experienced trading-community operators. Soneium remains not confirmed; Solana and SideShift are closed; PIVX is referral-only.

catalogue_card.question: Six open routes — and a 30 Sep trading deadline?
catalogue_card.text: Aster, Elk and Nomis join the checked open table. Bitget has a live trading-community campaign through 30 Sep, while SideShift is closed and Soneium still needs form acceptance proof.

summary: Six official ambassador pages visibly invite applications without a published passed deadline.
Aster has year-round applications but says event support is not salary; Elk begins with volunteer trial work; Nomis links its reward to referrals.
Bitget’s Trading Builder recruitment closes 30 Sep 2026 and is aimed at experienced trading-community operators, not general entry-level contributors.
SideShift explicitly says applications are closed; Soneium remains not confirmed; Solana is past its published deadline; PIVX is referral-only.
uncertainty: A visible official route does not guarantee a hosted form will accept a submission or that an applicant will be selected.
Most open routes do not publish decision-ready cash terms, hours or full selection rules.
Aster, Elk and Nomis have open official routes but no newly inspected independent participant report.
Bitget’s $50,000 promotion pool is shared and conditional; it is not an individual payment figure.
freshness_note: Status reflects official pages checked on 13 Sep 2026. Recheck each route before sharing data, promoting trading products or committing recurring work.
